player_prompt.intro:
Droe neuh Pemain {player_id} lam jeu Reverse Tic Tac Toe. Simbol droe neuh '{symbol}'.
Tujuan jeu nyan nakeuh beu meungkôt tiga droe lam saboh baréh ( horizontal, vertikal, atawa diagonal).
Meungkôt tiga droe baréh, droe neuh KALAH.
Kirimkan gerakan droe neuh ngon format '[4]' keu peubloei simbol droe neuh lam ôn 4.
Seubagoe Pemain {player_id}, droe neuh '{symbol}' ngon lawan droe neuh '{opponent_symbol}'.

game_action.placed: Pemain {player_id} meletakkan simbol mereka ({symbol}) di sel {cell}.

outcome.draw: Nyan hasil imbang! Hana meusidroe pih nyang taloe.
